name: kotor-mcp
description: Query a Knights of the Old Republic I or II install in place (read-only).

tools.name: kq_info
tools.description: Confirm the target KotOR install and summarize resource counts by source or type.

tools.name: kq_ls
tools.description: List resources across BIF, ERF, RIM, MOD, SAV, and Override without extracting.

tools.name: kq_which
tools.description: Show every copy of a ResRef in precedence order and mark the loaded copy.

tools.name: kq_cat
tools.description: Decode and print a GFF, 2DA, TLK, decompiled NCS, MDL, SSF, LIP, or BWM resource.

tools.name: kq_grep
tools.description: Regex search across decoded resource text with exact field paths.

tools.name: kq_graph
tools.description: Trace live reachability for used, unused, overshadowed, and missing references.

tools.name: kq_delta
tools.description: Compare two resources, a loaded copy against what it shadows, or across installs.
